source: TFT Search — current Set 18 listing. Initial database build contains a verified subset of the current augments; performance rankings are intentionally excluded.

entries.name: AFK
entries.description: You cannot perform actions for the next 3 rounds. Afterwards, gain 17 gold.

entries.name: Augmented Power
entries.description: Your next augment is one tier higher.

entries.name: Backup Bows
entries.description: Gain a Recurve Bow. After your champions attack 1000 times, get 2 more.

entries.name: Band of Thieves
entries.description: Gain 1 Thief's Gloves.

entries.name: Best Friends I
entries.description: Allies isolated in pairs gain 10% Attack Speed and 9 Armor and Magic Resist at the start of combat.

entries.name: Big Friend I
entries.description: Allies that start combat next to an ally with over 1750 Health gain 10% Durability. Gain a Giant's Belt.

entries.name: Boxing Lessons
entries.description: Your team gains 30 Health for each champion that starts combat in the front row.

entries.name: Branching Out
entries.description: Gain a random Emblem.

entries.name: Branching Out+
entries.description: Gain a random Emblem and a Reforger.

entries.name: Called Shot
entries.description: Set your win streak to +4. Gain 4 gold.

entries.name: Capital Gains I
entries.description: Store gold equal to the interest you earn. On 3-3, gain gold equal to 100% of the stored gold. Gain 1 gold now.

entries.name: Caretaker's Ally
entries.description: Gain a random 2-cost champion now. Gain the same one again every time you level up.

entries.name: Carve a Path
entries.description: Gain a B.F. Sword. After your champions deal 65000 physical damage, gain 2 more.

entries.name: Celestial Blessing I
entries.description: Your team gains 12% Omnivamp.

entries.name: Cognitive Tax
entries.description: Gain 8 gold and 1 XP.

entries.name: Cognitive Tax+
entries.description: Gain 12 gold and 3 XP.

entries.name: Component Buffet
entries.description: Whenever you would get a component, gain a component anvil instead. Gain a random component. The anvil offers 4 choices.

entries.name: Continuous Conjuration
entries.description: Gain a Needlessly Large Rod. After your team deals 42000 magic damage, gain 2 more.

entries.name: Corrosion
entries.description: Enemies in the first two rows lose 4 Armor and Magic Resist every 2 seconds.

entries.name: Crafted Crafting
entries.description: Whenever you craft a completed item, gain 2 rerolls.

entries.name: Eye For An Eye
entries.description: For every 15 ally champions that die, gain a random component (max 3).

entries.name: Eye For An Eye+
entries.description: Gain a random component. For every 18 ally champions that die, gain another component (max 2).

entries.name: Feeling Lucky
entries.description: Gain 12 gold, then flip a coin. If heads, gain 4 more gold.

entries.name: Find Your Center
entries.description: Your champion that starts combat in the center of the front row gains 15% Damage Amp and 25% max Health.

entries.name: Firesale
entries.description: Each round, steal a random 3-cost or lower champion from the shop. Gain 1 gold.

entries.name: Flame On
entries.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Inferno champions gain 0.2 Attack Damage and Ability Power. The one who did the most damage last combat gains double. Gain a Varus and an Akali.

entries.name: Flowing Tears
entries.description: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. After your champions spend 6500 Mana, gain 2 more.

entries.name: Focused Fire
entries.description: Your team gains 10% Attack Damage. Every 5 seconds, they gain 5% more.

entries.name: Forge a Friend
entries.description: The next 1-cost champion you buy is 3-star. Gain 5 gold.

entries.name: Future Focused
entries.description: Your Tactician loses 20 Health, but after 5 player combats, gain 3 4-cost champions and 8 gold.

entries.name: Glass Cannon I
entries.description: Allies that start combat in the back row begin combat at 80% Health but gain 16% Damage Amp.

entries.name: Good For Something I
entries.description: Champions that aren't holding items have a 40% chance to drop 1 gold on death.

entries.name: Group Hug I
entries.description: Combat start: Champions grant other adjacent champions 6 Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

entries.name: Pandora's Items I
entries.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 1 random component.

entries.name: Partial Ascension
entries.description: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 20% Damage Amp.

entries.name: Patience Is A Virtue
entries.description: Gain 4 rerolls now. Each round, gain 1 free reroll if you did not buy a champion last round.

entries.name: Placebo
entries.description: Your team gains 1% Attack Speed. Gain 8 gold.

entries.name: Placebo+
entries.description: Your team gains 1% Attack Speed. Gain 14 gold.

entries.name: Pocket Recombobulator
entries.description: Get 2 Pocket Recombobulators, a consumable that transforms a 1 or 2-cost champion into one of a higher cost. They keep their Star level. Also receive 2 Reforgers.

entries.name: Preparation I
entries.description: Champions on your bench permanently gain 30 Health, 3% Attack Damage, and 3% Ability Power every round. Champions start with 1 stack of this effect, and can stack up to 4 times.

entries.name: Quick Streaks
entries.description: You gain twice as much progress towards win and loss streaks. Gain 2 gold.

entries.name: Reroll Transfer
entries.description: For every 1 unused Augment Reroll, gain 3 free shop rerolls. Gain 1 gold. Does not include the round this augment is selected.

entries.name: Residual Magic
entries.description: Your team gains 60 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10. After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 40% of their missing Health.

entries.name: Silver Destiny
entries.description: Gain a random Silver Augment and 2 gold.

entries.name: Silver Destiny+
entries.description: Gain a random Silver Augment and 4 gold.

entries.name: Silver Destiny++
entries.description: Gain a random Silver Augment and 7 gold.

entries.name: Silver Spoon
entries.description: Gain 10 XP.

entries.name: Size Matters
entries.description: Gain a Giant's Belt. After a champion starts combat with more than max Health, gain a Warmog's Armor.

entries.name: Slice of Life
entries.description: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving 1 5-cost champion.

entries.name: Slightly Magic Roll
entries.description: Roll a die. Gain rewards based on the number rolled.

entries.name: Small Grab Bag
entries.description: Gain 2 random item components.

entries.name: Stand United
entries.description: Your units gain 1.5% Attack Damage and 1.5% Ability Power for each non-unique Trait active across your team.

entries.name: Survivor
entries.description: Gain 4 gold. After 3 players are eliminated, gain 100 more gold.

entries.name: Team Building
entries.description: Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator. Gain another after 5 player combats. This item allows you to copy a 3-cost or less champion.

entries.name: The Tower
entries.description: Gain a giant Training Dummy. Every 4 seconds, it zaps the 3 nearest enemies dealing 5% max Health true damage.

entries.name: Wisp Rebate+
entries.description: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain 2 gold. Gain 8 gold now.

entries.name: Young and Wild and Free
entries.description: You can always move freely on Carousel rounds. Gain 5 gold.

entries.name: A Magic Roll
entries.description: Roll 3 dice. Gain rewards based on their total.

entries.name: A Story of Seven Gold
entries.description: Collect Golden Balls by defeating players in combat. Collect all 7 for a reward, then restart the quest with more powerful rewards. Gain a 2-star 1-cost champion to start your journey.

entries.name: Advanced Loan
entries.description: Gain 20 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

entries.name: Advanced Loan+
entries.description: Gain 33 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

entries.name: Aim For The Top!
entries.description: You are more likely to fight stronger players, and you know who you will fight. When you lose, gain 2 XP. After your first win and every 3 wins after, gain a component.

entries.name: All That Shimmers
entries.description: Choose a gold-generating Artifact item and gain a Magnetic Remover.

entries.name: Another One!
entries.description: The next completed item you make grants an additional copy of it. Gain 5 gold now.

entries.name: Arcane Viktor-y
entries.description: After 8 seconds of combat, stun the enemy team for 1.5 seconds. Repeat this after 18 seconds of combat.

entries.name: Ascension
entries.description: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 35% Damage Amp.

entries.name: Aura Farming
entries.description: Gain a 2-star 5-cost champion holding a recommended item. You cannot field it until Stage 4-3.

entries.name: Backline Blueprint
entries.description: Gain a 3-cost non-Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

entries.name: Beast Within
entries.description: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi now and a Nidalee after 3 rounds.

entries.name: Beast Within+
entries.description: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi and a Nidalee.

entries.name: Big Grab Bag
entries.description: Gain 3 random components, 2 gold, and 1 Reforger.

entries.name: Birthday Reunion
entries.description: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion. At Level 6, gain a random item component. At Level 9, gain a random 2-star 5-cost champion.

entries.name: Blood Offering
entries.description: Gain a Bloodthirster. Combat start: Allies holding Bloodthirsters lose 15% Health but gain a 20% Health shield and 12% Attack Damage and Ability Power.

entries.name: Blood Rage
entries.description: Your allies gain 12-25% Damage Amp based on their missing Health. Maximum Damage Amp gained at 30% Health.

entries.name: Cybernetic Uplink
entries.description: Your champions holding an item gain 100 Health and 2 Mana Regen. Gain a Tear of the Goddess.

entries.name: Dark Ritual
entries.description: Converting Coven Essence to rewards grants Coven champions Ability Power instead of loot. Gain a Camille, an Elise, and a Caitlyn.

entries.name: Double Trouble
entries.description: When you field exactly 2 copies of a champion, they both gain 30% Attack Damage and 30% Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist. When you 3-star, gain a 2-star copy.

entries.name: Duo Queue
entries.description: Gain 2 random 5-cost champions and 2 copies of a random component.

entries.name: Embiggen
entries.description: Fae pixies are now larger and grant 50% more Attack Damage and Ability Power. Fae champions gain 10% Attack Damage and Ability Power immediately. Gain a Xayah and a Rakan.

entries.name: Epic Rolldown
entries.description: When you reach Level 8, gain 20 Shop rerolls.

entries.name: Epoch
entries.description: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain 4 XP and 2 free rerolls.

entries.name: Exclusive Customization
entries.description: Gain a Lucky Item Chest, a Magnetic Remover and 7 gold.

entries.name: Exiles II
entries.description: Your champions that start combat with no adjacent champions gain a 30% max Health shield for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Feed the Flames
entries.description: Gain a Sunfire Cape. Your team gains 12% Omnivamp when attacking Burning enemies.

entries.name: FOURcing
entries.description: Gain a random 4-cost champion. For each item equipped to that champion, your team gains 100 Health.

entries.name: Frontline Foundation
entries.description: Gain a 2-star 1-cost Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

entries.name: Gilded Steel
entries.description: Gain two 5-cost champions. If you field at least one 5-cost champion, your 1 to 4-cost champions gain 8% Durability.

entries.name: Glass Cannon II
entries.description: Allies that start combat in the back row begin combat at 80% Health but gain 25% Damage Amp.

entries.name: Gold Destiny
entries.description: Gain a random Gold Augment and 3 gold.

entries.name: Gold For Dummies
entries.description: Gain a Training Dummy. Every 10 seconds, all Training Dummies grant 1 gold.

entries.name: Infinity Protection
entries.description: Gain 3 gold now. On Stage 3-7, gain an Infinity Force. Infinity Force gives allies in the same row a 12% Health shield.

entries.name: Know Your Enemy
entries.description: You can see who you will fight next. Your team gains 8% Damage Amp, increased to 15% if you and your opponent have any of the same traits active.

entries.name: Late Game Scaling
entries.description: Gain 2 XP at the start of player combat rounds. Your 5-cost champions gain 12% Health and 12% Attack Speed.

entries.name: Last Second Save
entries.description: The first time each ally falls below 35% Health, they restore 20% maximum Health.

entries.name: Portable Forge
entries.description: Choose 1 of 4 Artifacts. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.

entries.name: Preparation II
entries.description: Champions on your bench permanently gain 50 Health, 5% Attack Damage, and 5% Ability Power every round. Champions start with 1 stack of this effect, and can stack up to 4 times.

entries.name: Prizefighter
entries.description: Gain 2 item components. Every 5 wins gives you an item component.

entries.name: Promised Protection
entries.description: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder 20% additional Mana from all sources and 200 max Health.

entries.name: Psychic Forge
entries.description: Round start Completed Items on benched champions turn into one of their recommended items. Gain a random completed item.

entries.name: Pumping Up II
entries.description: Your team gains 10% Attack Speed. After each round, they gain 1% more.

entries.name: Pyromaniac
entries.description: Gain a Red Buff. Your Burns deal 50% increased damage.

entries.name: Quiet Quitting
entries.description: For the next 3 player combats, you cannot use your shop. After, gain 24 gold and a Completed Item Anvil.

entries.name: Raining Gold
entries.description: Gain 7 gold now and 1 gold every round.

entries.name: ReinFOURcement
entries.description: The next 4-cost champion you buy with gold is instantly upgraded to 2-star. Gain 7 gold.

entries.name: Spreading Roots
entries.description: Gain random Emblems. After 3 combats, gain another.

entries.name: Staffsmith
entries.description: Gain 2 random completed items that build from Needlessly Large Rod.

entries.name: Stars Are Born
entries.description: The first 1-cost and 2-cost champions you buy are instantly upgraded to 2-star. Gain 7 gold.

entries.name: Sun and Moon
entries.description: Your Lunar champions gain 100 Health and 8% Damage Amp for each unique Solar champion fielded. Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and a Diana.

entries.name: Sunfire Board
entries.description: Combat Start: Burn all enemies for 18% of their max Health over 18 seconds and reduce healing received by 33%.

entries.name: Swordsmith
entries.description: Gain 2 random completed items that build from B.F. Sword.

entries.name: Verticality II
entries.description: Champions gain 2% Attack Damage, 2% Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

entries.name: Warpath
entries.description: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing 80 player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items.

entries.name: Woven Magic
entries.description: Gain a random item component. Every 2200 Mana spent by your champions grants an additional component.

entries.name: You Have My Bow
entries.description: Gain a Recurve Bow. Your team gains 12% Attack Speed.

entries.name: An Exalted Adventure
entries.description: Gain three 2-cost champions. If you 3-star two of them, gain an orb filled with loot. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator at the start of next 2 stages.

entries.name: At What Cost
entries.description: Immediately go to level 6 and gain 8 XP. You don't get to choose your future augments.

entries.name: Band of Thieves II
entries.description: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 5 player combats, gain another.

entries.name: Level Up!
entries.description: When you buy XP, gain an additional 2. Gain 6 immediately.

entries.name: Living Forge
entries.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil now and after every 10 player combats.

entries.name: Lucky Gloves
entries.description: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves and gold.

entries.name: Luxury Subscription
entries.description: Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and 3 gold. At the start of the next 2 stages, gain the package again.

entries.name: Master of All Origins
entries.description: Open an armory and choose one of 3 traits. Gain a Lux with that trait and a Spear of Shojin. Traits on your board are more likely to appear in the armory. Lux provides +2 to her chosen trait.

entries.name: Min-Max
entries.description: Gain a Golden Item Remover and 4 random components.

entries.name: Money Monsoon
entries.description: Gain 7 gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

entries.name: Nesting Anvils
entries.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 4 gold.

entries.name: Nesting Anvils+
entries.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 8 gold.

entries.name: Nesting Dolls
entries.description: After a champion dies in combat, spawn a copy of them one star level lower with 60% health. Gain 3 free rerolls.

entries.name: New Recruit
entries.description: Gain +1 max team size and 1 four-cost champion.

entries.name: New Recruit+
entries.description: Gain +1 max team size and 2 four-cost champions.

entries.name: Nine Lives
entries.description: Set your current and max player Health to 9. On combat loss, you only lose 1 health and gain loot. You can't gain health.

entries.name: One Buff Two Buff
entries.description: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

entries.name: Pandora's Items III
entries.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 1 Radiant item.

entries.name: Prismatic Destiny
entries.description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 4 gold.

entries.name: Prismatic Ticket
entries.description: Each time your shop is rerolled you have a 45% chance to gain a free reroll.

entries.name: Pumping Up III
entries.description: Your team gains 16% Attack Speed. After each round, they gain 2% more.

entries.name: Quality Over Quantity
entries.description: Champions holding exactly 1 item upgrade that item to Radiant. Champions holding Radiant items gain 7% Health. Gain 2 Magnetic Removers.

entries.name: Radiant Rascal
entries.description: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

entries.name: Radiant Refactor
entries.description: Gain a Masterwork Upgrade and 1 component anvil. Masterwork Upgrade upgrades an item to Radiant.
